canonical_statement: For every first-order language L, both the distinguished-subset downward Loewenheim-Skolem theorem at every admissible infinite cardinal and the elementary-embedding upward Loewenheim-Skolem theorem for every infinite structure at every admissible cardinal hold.
downward_conclusion: There exists S : L.ElementarySubstructure M with A subset S and lifted #S equal to lifted kappa.
upward_conclusion: There exists bundled L-structure N with a nonempty type of elementary embeddings M into N and #N = kappa.
degenerate_cases: A = empty, kappa = aleph0, kappa = #M, and empty languages remain included when hypotheses hold; finite M is excluded only from the upward clause; no proper-extension conclusion is imposed at equality.
